title: Multi-Agent Decision Gate
required_criteria: Project includes server-side and client-side code
optional_triggers: User mentions parallel or 多 agent
hard_rules: Multi-agent MUST NOT start without user confirmation
Multi-agent MUST NOT be the universal default
Multi-agent MUST NOT bypass the user for large projects

Decide later -> re-ask at next natural milestone
Declined -> do not re-ask for the same project phase
